🤖 Claude is watermarking AI content

Anthropic is adding invisible watermarks to content generated by Claude, and some users aren’t exactly thrilled.

The idea is to make it possible to identify whether something was created by Claude, even when there’s no visible label attached to it.

But that has some users worried.

If employers or universities can use these signals to identify AI-generated work, people fear Claude could make it easier to catch employees or students using AI behind the scenes.

Anthropic says the watermarking system isn’t foolproof. Heavy editing, formatting changes, or moving content between different platforms can weaken or remove the signal.
